menu_options.bridge: A Hue bridge the Hue integration already has
menu_options.syncbox: A Hue Play HDMI Sync Box

bridge.title: Philips Hue Plus
bridge.description: Choose the Hue bridge to add Hue Plus to.

takeover.title: The Hue integration's entities
takeover.description: Hue Plus makes its own entity for everything the Hue integration shows. What should happen to the Hue integration's entities?

bridge_direct.title: Connect to a Hue bridge
bridge_direct.description: Enter the address of the bridge. Hue Plus connects to it itself, without the Hue integration, and remembers the certificate the bridge shows now.

bridge_link.title: Press the link button
bridge_link.description: Press the round button on top of the bridge, then submit this form within thirty seconds.

menu_options.own_connection: Use my own connection to the bridge (instead of the Hue integration's)
menu_options.sync_developer: Spotify Sync with a Hue developer app

own_connection.title: The bridge's address
own_connection.description: Hue Plus will register with the bridge itself, so the Hue integration can be removed afterwards. Everything Hue Plus has made (entities, devices, names) stays. Enter the bridge's address.

own_connection_link.title: Press the link button
own_connection_link.description: Press the round button on top of the bridge, then submit this form within thirty seconds.

bridge_address.title: The bridge's address
bridge_address.description: Enter the new address of the same bridge. It has to show the same certificate as when Hue Plus registered with it.

sync_developer.title: Spotify Sync with a Hue developer app
sync_developer.description: Register {redirect} as the callback URL in your Hue developer app. Enter its App ID, Client ID and Client Secret, plus the Spotify Sync UUID from your extractor's UUID handoff.

sync_developer_reauth.title: Sign in to Philips Hue again
sync_developer_reauth.description: Continue to renew the Hue developer connection for the linked Spotify Sync account.

bridge_reauth.title: Register with the bridge again
bridge_reauth.description: The bridge no longer accepts Hue Plus, or shows another certificate. Press the round button on top of the bridge, then submit this form within thirty seconds.

syncbox.title: Hue Play HDMI Sync Box
syncbox.description: Enter the address of the sync box (its name on the network or its IP address).

syncbox_register.title: Register with the sync box
syncbox_register.description: Hold the button on the sync box until its light turns green, then submit this form.

syncbox_reauth.title: Register with the sync box again
syncbox_reauth.description: The sync box no longer accepts Hue Plus. Hold the button on the box until its light turns green, then submit this form.

reauth_confirm.title: Hue Spotify sync
reauth_confirm.description: The sync service no longer accepts the stored token.

reauth_credentials.title: Hue Spotify sync credentials
reauth_credentials.description: Enter the new token and UUID.

error.invalid_auth: The sync service does not accept this token. Check the token and the UUID.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address and the network.
error.invalid_client_credentials: Enter the Client ID or Client Secret from your Hue developer app.
error.invalid_app_id: Enter the App ID from your Hue developer app.
error.invalid_uuid: Enter the Spotify Sync UUID from the extractor handoff.
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Hue account than the stored one.
error.invalid_host: That is not a name or an address.
error.not_v2: This bridge is too old: Hue Plus needs a bridge with the v2 API.
error.link_button_not_pressed: The bridge did not register Hue Plus. Press its round button, then submit again.
error.wrong_bridge: This is a different bridge than the one Hue Plus was set up for.
error.certificate_changed: The bridge shows another certificate than when Hue Plus registered with it. Register again instead (re-authentication).
error.registration_pending: The box did not register Hue Plus. Hold its button until the light turns green, then submit again.

abort.no_hue_bridge: Set up the Hue integration first (it has to use the bridge's v2 API).
abort.use_hue_integration: The Hue integration already has this bridge. Add it from the first choice, which uses the Hue integration's connection.
abort.no_reconfigure: This entry has no bridge settings to change.
abort.sync_developer_successful: Hue developer sign-in is configured for Spotify Sync.
abort.invalid_auth: Hue Sync did not accept this account and UUID.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not verify Spotify Sync. Try again later.
abort.missing_configuration: Add your Hue developer Client ID and Client Secret in Home Assistant Application credentials, then try again.
abort.own_connection_successful: Hue Plus now has its own connection to the bridge. The Hue integration can be removed.
abort.already_configured: Hue Plus is already set up for this bridge.
abort.no_options: A sync box has no options.

streaming.title: Register for local streaming
streaming.description: Press the round link button on the Hue bridge, then submit this form. Hue Plus asks the bridge for its own key, which streaming needs; it shows up in the bridge's list of authorized apps.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Switch on what you want. The Spotify sync needs a token from your Hue account, which is asked for next.

credentials.title: Hue Spotify sync credentials
credentials.description: Paste the token and UUID from the extractor, or turn on Enter developer credentials and submit to set up automatic renewal.

error.invalid_auth: The sync service does not accept this token. Check the token and the UUID.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address and the network.
error.required: Enter a value for this field.
error.link_button_not_pressed: The bridge did not register Hue Plus. Press its link button, then submit again.

abort.no_options: A sync box has no options.

options.alongside: Leave them alone: nothing is hidden or renamed, so existing dashboards and automations keep working. Hue Plus's entities get the same names ending in _plus.
options.replace: Hide and rename them: the Hue integration's entities are hidden and renamed (ending in _hue), and Hue Plus's entities take their names, so existing dashboards and automations use Hue Plus.

options.bridge: Bridge: firmware, apps, automations, scenes, rooms, entertainment areas, Matter, settings
options.lights: Lights: Hue Plus's own light entities, next to or in place of the Hue integration's
options.devices: Devices: the Hue integration's sensors, buttons, scenes, switches and selects, taken over
options.zones: Zones: per-zone control of gradient lights
options.streaming: Streaming: send colours straight to an entertainment area (experimental; needs a registration with the bridge)
options.sync: Spotify sync: start, stop and tune Hue's cloud sync

get_resources.name: Get resources
get_resources.description: Returns what the bridge holds: authorized apps, automations and their templates, rooms, zones, scenes, smart scenes, entertainment areas, Matter fabrics, devices, firmware and bridge status.

kinds.name: Kinds
kinds.description: What to return. Everything when empty.

timed_effect.name: Timed effect
timed_effect.description: Starts a sunrise or sunset on a light: it fades over the duration. Use no_effect to stop one.

light.name: Light
light.description: The light: its Hue id, the name of its device, or its Home Assistant entity.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long it takes, in seconds (not needed for no_effect).

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: Makes a light signal: it blinks for a while and then goes back to what it was doing.

light.name: Light
light.description: The light: its Hue id, the name of its device, or its Home Assistant entity.

colors_xy.name: Colors xy
colors_xy.description: One or two colours as [x, y] pairs, for the signals that use colours.

set_power_on.name: Set power on
set_power_on.description: Sets what a light does when it gets power: safety (a warm white), powerfail (back to how it was), last_on_state, or custom with the state to switch on with.

light.name: Light
light.description: The light: its Hue id, the name of its device, or its Home Assistant entity.

on.name: On
on.description: For custom: switch on, toggle, or keep the previous state.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: For custom: the brightness in percent.

color_temperature_kelvin.name: Color temperature kelvin
color_temperature_kelvin.description: For custom: a white temperature in kelvin.

color_xy.name: Color xy
color_xy.description: For custom: a colour as an [x, y] pair.

set_motion_area.name: Set motion area
set_motion_area.description: Switches a MotionAware area on or off, renames it, or sets how sensitive it is. A MotionAware area uses the lights themselves as a motion sensor (Bridge Pro).

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: The devices that sense motion from now on (three or four; names, ids or device ids).

sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How sensitive it is, from 0 (the least) to the area's own maximum (4 on the bridge it was tried on).

create_motion_area.name: Create motion area
create_motion_area.description: Creates a MotionAware area from three or four lights of a room or zone. A new area still has to be calibrated before it senses motion (see the Hue app).

group.name: Group
group.description: The room or zone (id or name).

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: The lights (names, ids or device ids), three or four.

set_motion_area_lights.name: Set motion area lights
set_motion_area_lights.description: Sets what a MotionAware area does when it senses motion: from each time, motion recalls a scene and, after some minutes without motion, the lights go off. Replaces what was set before.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: The rooms (up to three) or the one zone whose lights it controls (ids or names).

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: The times: a list of {"time": "07:00", "scene": "<scene name or id>", "off_after_minutes": 10}, or {"sun": "sunset", "offset_minutes": -30, ...} to start at sunrise or sunset. Leave off_after_minutes out to leave the lights on, and scene out to leave them alone.

dark_threshold.name: Dark threshold
dark_threshold.description: Act only when it is darker than this light level (0 to 65534). Leave out to act in daylight too.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

set_streaming_end_state.name: Set streaming end state
set_streaming_end_state.description: Experimental. Sets what the lights of an entertainment area do when a sync stops: back to the last state, off, stay as they are (pause), or a scene. Only last_state has been seen on a real bridge; the other names are guesses.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: For scene: the scene (id or name).

configure_light.name: Configure light
configure_light.description: Experimental. Sets what a light is for (decorative, functional or mixed, as in the Hue app) and, for a gradient light, which way it is mounted. Not yet tried on a real bridge.

light.name: Light
light.description: The light: its Hue id, the name of its device, or its Home Assistant entity.

identify.name: Identify
identify.description: Makes a light flash briefly so you can see which one it is.

light.name: Light
light.description: The light: its Hue id, the name of its device, or its Home Assistant entity.

set_name.name: Set name
set_name.description: Renames a light, device, room, zone, scene, entertainment area or automation. For a light, room or zone it can also set the icon type.

archetype.name: Archetype
archetype.description: The icon type, for example bedroom or floor_shade.

create_scene.name: Create scene
create_scene.description: Creates a scene for a room or zone. Without actions it records how the lights in it look right now.

group.name: Group
group.description: The room or zone (id or name).

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Only these lights (names or ids). All lights of the group when empty.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: The scene's actions as the bridge writes them, instead of recording the current look.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast a dynamic scene moves, from 0 to 1.

auto_dynamic.name: Auto dynamic
auto_dynamic.description: Whether it starts moving when recalled.

update_scene.name: Update scene
update_scene.description: Changes a scene: its name, speed, whether it starts moving, or its actions.

auto_dynamic.name: Auto dynamic
auto_dynamic.description: Whether it starts moving when recalled.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: New actions as the bridge writes them.

record_current.name: Record current
record_current.description: Records how the scene's lights look right now as its actions (after adjusting them), instead of giving actions.

delete_scene.name: Delete scene
delete_scene.description: Deletes a scene from the bridge.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

set_smart_scene.name: Set smart scene
set_smart_scene.description: Turns a smart scene (a scene that changes with the time of day) on or off.

create_smart_scene.name: Create smart scene
create_smart_scene.description: Creates a smart scene. The week's time slots are passed to the bridge as they are.

week_timeslots.name: Week timeslots
week_timeslots.description: The time slots as the bridge writes them.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

create_room.name: Create room
create_room.description: Creates a room. A room holds devices; a device can be in one room only.

archetype.name: Archetype
archetype.description: The icon type, for example bedroom.

update_room.name: Update room
update_room.description: Renames a room, changes its icon type, or replaces the devices in it.

members.name: Members
members.description: The devices in it from now on (names or ids).

delete_room.name: Delete room
delete_room.description: Deletes a room. Its lights stay on the bridge, unassigned.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

create_zone.name: Create zone
create_zone.description: Creates a zone. A zone holds lights, and a light can be in several zones.

update_zone.name: Update zone
update_zone.description: Renames a zone, changes its icon type, or replaces the lights in it.

members.name: Members
members.description: The lights in it from now on (names or ids).

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

create_entertainment_area.name: Create entertainment area
create_entertainment_area.description: Creates an entertainment area: the lights that take part in music, screen or game sync and where they stand.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: The lights with their positions from -1 to 1, as a list of items with light, x, y and z.

update_entertainment_area.name: Update entertainment area
update_entertainment_area.description: Renames an entertainment area, changes its type, or replaces its lights and positions.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: The lights with their positions, as a list of items with light, x, y and z (and balance, the brightness balance, more than 0; it stays as it is when left out). A light that stays keeps its balance and the other positions of its segments.

performance.name: Performance
performance.description: Who streams: the bridge picks (auto) or one light does (manual). Experimental.

performance_light.name: Performance light
performance_light.description: The light that streams, for manual performance.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

control_entertainment_area.name: Control entertainment area
control_entertainment_area.description: Starts or stops streaming to an entertainment area from Home Assistant's own connection.

create_automation.name: Create automation
create_automation.description: Creates a Hue automation on the bridge from a template (see automation_templates in get_resources).

configuration.name: Configuration
configuration.description: Its configuration, as the template's schema describes.

update_automation.name: Update automation
update_automation.description: Changes a Hue automation: name, configuration or whether it is on.

trigger_automation.name: Trigger automation
trigger_automation.description: The play button of the Hue app: starts or stops a wake up, go to sleep, timer or mimic presence automation. It works whether or not the automation is switched on, which is how a Go to sleep or a timer that only starts by hand is used.

delete_automation.name: Delete automation
delete_automation.description: Deletes a Hue automation from the bridge.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

revoke_app.name: Revoke app
revoke_app.description: Takes an authorized app's key away so it can no longer use the bridge. Find the id in the apps of get_resources. Home Assistant's own key cannot be revoked here.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

configure_bridge.name: Configure bridge
configure_bridge.description: Changes the bridge's name or time zone.

time_zone.name: Time zone
time_zone.description: A time zone such as Europe/Istanbul.

set_auto_update.name: Set auto update
set_auto_update.description: Sets whether the bridge installs updates by itself, and at what time of day.

check_for_update.name: Check for update
check_for_update.description: Makes the bridge check for a new firmware version now.

install_bridge_update.name: Install bridge update
install_bridge_update.description: Installs a bridge firmware update that is ready. The bridge restarts, and lights stay as they are.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

set_home_location.name: Set home location
set_home_location.description: Sets the bridge's home location. Sunrise and sunset, Coming home at night and the bridge's other location-based automations need it. The menu's button gives it Home Assistant's own home location.

set_zigbee_channel.name: Set zigbee channel
set_zigbee_channel.description: Changes the Zigbee channel of the bridge. Every light and accessory has to find the bridge again, and some may not.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: A channel from 11 to 26 (11, 15, 20 and 25 are the ones that avoid Wi-Fi).

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

press_link_button.name: Press link button
press_link_button.description: Opens the bridge for new apps for about 30 seconds, as pressing its button does.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

search_for_devices.name: Search for devices
search_for_devices.description: Makes the bridge search for new lights and accessories for about 40 seconds.

allow_default_link_key.name: Allow default link key
allow_default_link_key.description: Also accept devices that use the default Zigbee key (older lights).

remove_device.name: Remove device
remove_device.description: Removes a light or accessory from the bridge. It has to be reset before it can be added again.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

create_routine.name: Create routine
create_routine.description: Makes a routine for a room or zone from the bridge's own template. Wake-up fades the lights up, go-to-sleep fades them out and turns them off, a timer recalls a scene after a while, a schedule recalls a scene at a time (optionally until another time, optionally at randomised times), coming home recalls a scene when you arrive (optionally only between two times; needs Home and Away), leaving home turns the lights off when everyone leaves, the smoke alarm template lights the room when a smoke alarm sounds.

group.name: Group
group.description: The room or zone (id or name).

time.name: Time
time.description: The time of day (wake-up, go-to-sleep and schedule), or the time coming home starts.

until.name: Until
until.description: Schedule: the time it ends. Coming home: the time it stops (give both or neither).

days.name: Days
days.description: The days. Every day when empty.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the fade or the timer takes, in minutes (a fade: 15 for wake-up and 30 for go-to-sleep when empty).

end_brightness.name: End brightness
end_brightness.description: Wake-up: the brightness it ends on, 1 to 100.

style.name: Style
style.description: Wake-up: sunrise or basic (a plain fade). Go-to-sleep: sunset or basic.

turn_off_after_minutes.name: Turn off after minutes
turn_off_after_minutes.description: Wake-up: switch the lights off this many minutes after it ends.

randomize_minutes.name: Randomize minutes
randomize_minutes.description: Schedule: shift the times by up to this many minutes.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Timer, schedule and coming home: the scene to recall (id or name).

end_state.name: End state
end_state.description: Go to sleep: what the lights end on (turn_off, minimum_brightness, nightlight). Mimic presence: do_nothing or turn_off.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Mimic presence: 24h is all day, nighttime only when it is dark.

excluded_lights.name: Excluded lights
excluded_lights.description: Mimic presence: what happens to the lights of the rooms that are not chosen.

when_type.name: When type
when_type.description: Coming home: always, or only at night (needs the bridge's home location).

start_type.name: Start type
start_type.description: Schedule: start at a time of day, at sunrise or at sunset (those need the bridge's home location).

until_type.name: Until type
until_type.description: Schedule: end at a time of day, at sunrise or at sunset.

action.name: Action
action.description: Schedule: recall a scene, or switch the lights on or off.

update_routine.name: Update routine
update_routine.description: Changes a routine made from the bridge's wake-up, go-to-sleep, timer, schedule, coming home, leaving home or smoke alarm template. The settings are written again, so give all of them.

group.name: Group
group.description: The room or zone (id or name).

time.name: Time
time.description: The time of day (wake-up, go-to-sleep and schedule), or the time coming home starts.

until.name: Until
until.description: Schedule: the time it ends. Coming home: the time it stops (give both or neither).

days.name: Days
days.description: The days. Every day when empty.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the fade or the timer takes, in minutes (a fade: 15 for wake-up and 30 for go-to-sleep when empty).

end_brightness.name: End brightness
end_brightness.description: Wake-up: the brightness it ends on, 1 to 100.

style.name: Style
style.description: Wake-up: sunrise or basic (a plain fade). Go-to-sleep: sunset or basic.

turn_off_after_minutes.name: Turn off after minutes
turn_off_after_minutes.description: Wake-up: switch the lights off this many minutes after it ends.

randomize_minutes.name: Randomize minutes
randomize_minutes.description: Schedule: shift the times by up to this many minutes.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Timer, schedule and coming home: the scene to recall (id or name).

end_state.name: End state
end_state.description: Go to sleep: what the lights end on (turn_off, minimum_brightness, nightlight). Mimic presence: do_nothing or turn_off.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Mimic presence: 24h is all day, nighttime only when it is dark.

excluded_lights.name: Excluded lights
excluded_lights.description: Mimic presence: what happens to the lights of the rooms that are not chosen.

when_type.name: When type
when_type.description: Coming home: always, or only at night (needs the bridge's home location).

start_type.name: Start type
start_type.description: Schedule: start at a time of day, at sunrise or at sunset (those need the bridge's home location).

until_type.name: Until type
until_type.description: Schedule: end at a time of day, at sunrise or at sunset.

action.name: Action
action.description: Schedule: recall a scene, or switch the lights on or off.

configure_button.name: Configure button
configure_button.description: Sets what one press of one button of a dimmer, smart button or tap switch does. The button must already have an action set up in the Hue app.

button.name: Button
button.description: The button's number on the accessory.

action.name: Action
action.description: What it does: dim up or down, turn the lights off (all_off) or the entire home off (home_off), do nothing, recall one scene, cycle through several scenes, or a time-based light.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: For scene: the scene to recall (id or name).

scenes.name: Scenes
scenes.description: For scene_cycle: the scenes in the order of the presses, as a list of ids or names (2 to 10).

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: For time_based: the times and scenes, as a list of items with "time" (for example 07:00) and "scene". Left out: the Hue app's own schedule (07:00 Energize, 10:00 Concentrate, 17:00 Read, 20:00 Relax, 23:00 Nightlight) from the scenes of the button's room.

repeat_timeout.name: Repeat timeout
repeat_timeout.description: For scene_cycle and time_based: seconds after which the next press starts again (1 to 10).

with_off.name: With off
with_off.description: For scene, scene_cycle and time_based: smart on/off, the next press after the last turns the lights off.

create_daily_smart_scene.name: Create daily smart scene
create_daily_smart_scene.description: Makes a smart scene that changes through the day, for example a bright scene in the morning and a warm one in the evening, the same on the days you choose. Not yet tried on a real bridge.

group.name: Group
group.description: The room or zone (id or name).

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: The times and scenes: a list of items, each with "time" (for example 07:00) and "scene" (a scene name or id).

days.name: Days
days.description: The days. Every day when empty.

light_step.name: Light step
light_step.description: Makes lights brighter or dimmer, warmer or cooler, by a step from where they are now. The bridge does the arithmetic, so it is smooth and several presses in a row add up.

brightness_step.name: Brightness step
brightness_step.description: Percent brighter (positive) or dimmer (negative), from -100 to 100.

mirek_step.name: Mirek step
mirek_step.description: Warmer (positive) or cooler (negative) in mirek, up to 347 (the whole range). A higher mirek is a warmer white.

configure_sensor.name: Configure sensor
configure_sensor.description: Turns a motion sensor on or off and sets how sensitive it is. Experimental: not tried on a real sensor.

sensor.name: Sensor
sensor.description: The motion sensor (id or the name of its device).

sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How sensitive, from 0 up to the sensor's maximum.

remove_matter_fabric.name: Remove matter fabric
remove_matter_fabric.description: Disconnects a Matter ecosystem (see matter_fabrics in get_resources).

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: this cannot be undone.

raw_request.name: Raw request
raw_request.description: A request to the bridge's v2 API as it is, for what has no service of its own. Anything but GET needs confirm.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true for anything but GET.

set_style.name: Set style
set_style.description: Sets the style of a gradient light (the Hue app's Linear, Mirrored, Scattered and Segmented) and/or turns its zones around. The colours are kept as far as the new style has room for them.

light.name: Light
light.description: The gradient light: its Hue id, or the entity of its zones light.

flip.name: Flip
flip.description: Turn the zones around (the first zone becomes the last).

set_effect.name: Set effect
set_effect.description: Starts one of the lights' own effects with a colour and speed of your choice, as the Hue app does when you run the underwater effect in yellow.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: The lights (Hue ids or light entities).

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: The effect, for example candle, fireplace, prism, sparkle or no_effect.

hs_color.name: Hs color
hs_color.description: A colour as [hue, saturation]. Not together with kelvin.

kelvin.name: Kelvin
kelvin.description: A white temperature in kelvin. Not together with hs_color.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast the effect moves, from 0 to 1.

set_gradient.name: Set gradient
set_gradient.description: Writes the colour points of a gradient light. The points it had before are saved to a file in the configuration folder first, so the change can be put back.

light.name: Light
light.description: The gradient light: its Hue id, or the entity of its zones light.

points.name: Points
points.description: The points as [x, y] colours, from the start of the light to its end.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The gradient mode, one of those the light offers.

import_hue_scene.name: Import hue scene
import_hue_scene.description: Reads the palette, speed and lights of a Hue scene so that it can be saved as a live scene, and what it sets each light to so that it can be saved as a classic one. Reads only; nothing is written to the bridge.

stream_colors.name: Stream colors
stream_colors.description: Experimental. Streams colours straight to the lights of an entertainment area (no scene, no delay), for a number of seconds. Needs the streaming module and a registration with the bridge. The area cannot be used by another sync at the same time.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: One [red, green, blue] colour for every light of the area, or one per light in the order of the area's channels.

stop_streaming.name: Stop streaming
stop_streaming.description: Experimental. Stops the stream to an entertainment area, or to all of them.

area.name: Area
area.description: The entertainment area (id or name). All when empty.

activate_scene.name: Activate scene
activate_scene.description: Starts a Hue scene with the options the scene's turn on action does not have: live (dynamic) at a speed, a brightness and a fade time. These are the options of the Hue integration's action of the same name.

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Play the scene live, its colours keep moving, instead of showing it as a still picture.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast a live scene moves, from 0 to 100 percent.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: The brightness the scene starts with, from 1 to 255.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: The fade time in seconds, from 0 to 3600.

play_effect.name: Play effect
play_effect.description: Plays one of a Hue light's own effects with a chosen colour, which the light's turn on action cannot (it clears the colour when it is given an effect). The dashboard plays live scenes through it. Experimental.

xy.name: Xy
xy.description: The colour as [x, y], each from 0 to 1.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: How fast the effect runs, from 0 (slow) to 1 (fast).
